title: How important is GVC participation for export upgrading?
summary: High-quality exports need knowledge-intensive production, quality inputs and advanced technology, and global value chains are one route to them. Using product-level export data, the paper finds that participation in backward and forward GVCs raises the quality of exported products.
keyFindings: GVC participation raises the quality of exported products.
The benefit differs by income group.
Developing countries benefit only from backward GVC participation.
methods: Highly disaggregated product-level export data for 122 countries.
